notice: Pressing the microphone asks for browser permission and may send audio to your browser's speech service. Sonnic does not store audio. You can edit the text before submitting.
unsupported: Speech recognition is unavailable in this browser. Type your dream or try a browser that supports the Web Speech API.
starting: Connecting speech recognition… Your browser may request microphone access.
done: Recognized text was added. Review and edit it before submitting.
cancelled: Recording cancelled. Your original text is unchanged.

errors.not-allowed: Microphone access was denied. Allow it in site settings or type your dream.
errors.service-not-allowed: The recognition service is unavailable in this browser or region. Type your dream instead.
errors.audio-capture: The microphone is missing or busy. Check its connection and settings.
errors.network: The recognition service could not be reached. Your original text is unchanged.
errors.no-speech: No speech was recognized. Try again or type your dream.
errors.language-not-supported: Your browser cannot recognize this language.
errors.aborted: Recognition was interrupted. Your original text is unchanged.
errors.timeout: The browser did not finish recognition. Try again.
errors.too-long: The recognized text exceeds 10,000 characters. Your original text is unchanged; try a shorter recording.
errors.unknown: Could not start recognition. You can type your dream instead.
errors.ended-early: The browser ended recognition before returning text. It gave no reason; this does not mean you were silent. Your draft is preserved.

recoveryHint: This may be an unfinished phrase. Edit it before inserting; the combined limit is 10,000 characters.
fallback: If recording stops immediately inside an app, try this same address in regular Chrome. A microphone button does not guarantee service availability. Copy your draft before switching.
windowsFallback: On Windows, select the dream field and press Win + H for system voice typing. It needs microphone access and internet; Microsoft processes the audio.
